元武大陆，以武为尊！
赵家庄，是元武大陆西北天元郡国下属巴立城外的一个不起眼小庄子。
可谓穷乡僻壤。
庄外靠近悬崖的小树林边，倒卧着一名脸色苍白的单薄少年，山风吹过，少年眉头颤动了几下，眼睛忽然睁开了。
睁眼的一刹那，他就懵了。
“怎么回事？”
“我叶枫不是被车撞了吗？怎么会在这儿？”
没有喧沸的人声，没有红绿灯，更没有肇事卡车。
周围环境静谧的让叶枫惊愕，他脑海中莫名浮过两个字……
“穿越？”
低头看看身上的衣服，还没有彻底长开的双手双脚，根本不是原来的身体。
良久之后，叶枫默默无语。
他是一个来自西北贫苦小山村的孤儿，凭借努力考上华夏首屈一指的大学府，毕业后，更是几年内就在帝都闯出了一片天地，被誉为新一代的时代领军者，获得了政府嘉奖。
可谁都没想到，就在前往会场领奖的当晚，会遭逢车祸被撞到元武大陆这个以武为尊的世界。
调整了一下呼吸之后，叶枫开始整理起脑海中杂乱的思路，只是等他搞明白目前的状况，他的眉头又紧蹙起来。

原因无它。
这具身体前主人的身世、背景，实在是到了惨不忍睹的地步。
同样叫做叶枫，十五岁，昔日的叶家庄庄主叶天独子。
听上去似乎还不错，但问题的重点是，叶家庄已是过眼云烟，现在这巴立城范围内根本就没有“叶家庄”
这个地方。
七年前，在叶枫八岁的时，父亲叶天不知何故失踪，过了一年，母亲也积郁成疾死去了。
而让叶枫万分诧异的是，接下去发生了一次又一次的变故，所有跟叶家有旧的亲朋好友，不是死了就是销声匿迹，短短几年，叶姓族人死了个遍，目前只剩下叶枫和妹子花菱两根独苗。
叶家庄顺理成章变成了赵家庄，庄主则是叶天当年的结拜小弟赵大鹏。
对原本就是孤儿的叶枫而言，其实这都不算事，让他郁闷的是，这具身体的原主人叶枫，居然是无法觉醒武脉的废物体质，没有修炼天赋，连成为最基础的武士都做不到。
在这个以武为尊的世界，无法觉醒武脉成为武者就是彻彻底底的废物，完全没有人格可言。
如此一来，叶枫的生活自然掉进了地狱，叶家少主变成一个不姓赵的外人，而且是连修炼都无法做到的废物，地位，连下人都不如。
自那天起，每一天叶枫都过着不是人过的日子，备受欺凌。
侮辱，讥笑，嘲讽，打骂……
赵姓族人巴不得叶枫早点死，叶家虽然除名，可毕竟还有叶枫这个少主存活着，只要姓叶的一天没死绝，叶家庄改名赵家庄就是名不正言不顺。
所以每天他都会遭遇种种毫无理由的刁难，叶枫只能隐忍，和妹妹花菱像小强一样顽强的活着。

In Yuanwu Continent, martial arts is the most respected!
Zhaojiazhuang is an inconspicuous small village outside Bali City under Tianyuan County in the northwest of Yuanwu Continent.
It can be described as a remote place.
Outside the village, by the small woods near the cliff, lay a pale and thin young man. The mountain wind blew by, and the young man's brows trembled a few times, and his eyes suddenly opened.
The moment he opened his eyes, he was confused.
"What's going on?"
"Didn't I, Ye Feng, get hit by a car? Why am I here?"
There were no noisy people, no traffic lights, and no accidental trucks.
The surrounding environment was so quiet that Ye Feng was shocked, and two words came to his mind inexplicably...
"Time travel?"
Looking down at the clothes on his body, he saw that his hands and feet, which had not yet fully grown, were not his original body at all.
After a long time, Ye Feng was silent.
He was an orphan from a poor mountain village in the northwest. He worked hard to get into China's premier university. After graduation, he made a name for himself in the imperial capital within a few years. He was hailed as a new generation leader of the times and received government awards.
But no one expected that on the night they went to the venue to receive the award, they would be involved in a car accident and be thrown into the Yuanwu Continent, a world where martial arts is respected.
After adjusting his breathing, Ye Feng began to sort out the messy thoughts in his mind. But when he understood the current situation, his brows furrowed again.
There is no other reason.
The life experience and background of the previous owner of this body were truly horrific.
Also named Ye Feng, fifteen years old, the only son of Ye Tian, ​​the former owner of Yejiazhuang.
It sounds good, but the point of the problem is that Yejiazhuang has passed away, and now there is no "Yejiazhuang" within the scope of Bali City.
this place.
Seven years ago, when Ye Feng was eight years old, his father Ye Tian disappeared for unknown reasons. A year later, his mother also died of illness due to depression.
What surprised Ye Feng was that one incident after another happened. All the old relatives and friends of the Ye family either died or disappeared. In just a few years, all the members of the Ye family died, and now only two single seedlings, Ye Feng and his sister Hualing, were left.
Yejiazhuang naturally became Zhaojiazhuang, and the owner of the village was Zhao Dapeng, Ye Tian's sworn brother.
For Ye Feng, who was originally an orphan, this actually didn't matter. What made him depressed was that the original owner of this body, Ye Feng, had a useless physique that could not awaken martial arts. He had no talent for cultivation and could not even become the most basic warrior.
In this world where martial arts is respected, those who cannot awaken their martial veins and become warriors are complete losers and have no personality at all.
As a result, Ye Feng's life naturally fell into hell. The young master of the Ye family became an outsider not named Zhao, and he was a waste who could not even practice cultivation. His status was inferior to that of a servant.
From that day on, Ye Feng lived a different life every day and was bullied.
Insult, ridicule, ridicule, beat and scold...
The clan members surnamed Zhao wished that Ye Feng would die soon. Although the Ye family was expelled, there was still the young master Ye Feng alive after all. As long as the person named Ye did not die, the name of Yejiazhuang would be unfair if it was renamed Zhaojiazhuang.
So every day he would encounter all kinds of unreasonable difficulties. Ye Feng could only endure it and live as tenaciously as Xiao Qiang with his sister Hua Ling.
